stories.text: As a customer, I want to reset my password by email so that I can get back into my account
acceptance_criteria: The link opens the reset form
SEC: the token is single-use, random (128 bits or more) and expires in 15 minutes
SEC: the response is the same whether or not the email exists

stories.text: As a customer, I want to download my order history as CSV so that I can do my taxes
acceptance_criteria: CSV has one row per order
SEC: only the logged-in customer's orders are exported (owner check)
SEC: cells starting with = + - @ are escaped (CSV injection)

stories.text: As a customer, I want a dark theme so that the site is easier on my eyes
As a security champion, I want reset requests rate limited per IP and per account so that tokens cannot be brute forced
acceptance_criteria: SEC: the 6th request in 15 minutes gets HTTP 429

abuse_cases.text: As an attacker, I want to guess reset tokens so that I can take over accounts
abuse_cases.given: a reset token was issued for "alice"
abuse_cases.then: every attempt fails and further attempts get status 429

abuse_cases.text: As an attacker, I want to change the customer id in the export URL so that I can download other customers' orders
abuse_cases.when: I request the CSV export for customer "alice"

abuse_cases.text: As an attacker, I want to flood the reset form so that the mail server blocks the shop

retro_actions: Add the CSV injection check to the secure code review checklist
